messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — prod west-1 high external function invocations. Alert id: ALRT-2026-36321. Rule: external-action-exec-rate > 1k/min. Suspected surge from batch job fanout. https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/ALRT-2026-36321

maria_oncall: Picking this up. Setting pager. Any immediate customer-impact data?

jon_sre: Seeing spike starting ~3632099000. 95th percentile fncall latency unchanged, but exec Q depth increased x10. Top callers: public-api route /v1/agent/run (mostly free tier).

lina_prod_ops: Heads-up — acme-markets and orbitai show high fn usage in last 10m. Both have live customers using tool-calls for order enrichment. We need to avoid breaking paying customers.

maria_oncall: Agreed. Prioritize safety while minimizing breakage. Proposal: temporary firebreak for cross-tenant external invokes on public/free plans + downgrade structured_output to text-only for chat routes globally. Whitelist paid tenants that we mark as critical. Thoughts? :warning:

jon_sre: I can push emergency policy now. Plan (fast path):
```bash
# disable external function invoke for free/public plans
redwoodctl policy apply --scope=global --selector="plan:free" --set="allow_fncall:false" --annotate="incident=ALRT-2026-36321"

# set structured output to text fallback for chat models to reduce parsing/agent call overhead
redwoodctl route update --pattern="/v1/chat*" --set="structured_output:off,fallback=text" --annotate="incident=ALRT-2026-36321"

# create per-tenant soft-quota to limit fncalls for tenants over threshold
redwoodctl quota create --tenant=dynamic --metric=fncall_rate --limit=5/s --policy="soft" --annotate="incident=ALRT-2026-36321"
```

jon_sre: I will exclude tenants in the whitelist file `/etc/redwood/emergency_whitelist.json` (adding acme-markets/org-342) before applying.

lina_prod_ops: Adding acme-markets/org-342 and orbitai-enterprise/org-994 to whitelist now. Please confirm when applied so we can notify them.

sam_cs: I'll draft a short customer note: "We're temporarily restricting automated external calls to reduce system load. You may see fallbacks to text-only responses; if you rely on function execution, please reply here and we'll confirm your whitelist status." Put it in #customer-notify once we have final list.

maria_oncall: jon, please execute the commands and post the diff. Keep changes reversible. Marking severity P1 -> mitigation in progress.

jon_sre: Applying policy now. Pushing one change at a time.

incident-bot: Action log: policy.apply started by jon_sre at 3632101180 (txn: tx-ALRT-36321-1).

jon_sre: Policy applied: public/free fncall disabled. Route update completed: chat routes set to structured_output off. Soft quotas created. Diff: [PATCH HUNK]
- allow_fncall: true (plan:free)
+ allow_fncall: false (plan:free)
- structured_output: enabled
+ structured_output: fallback=text

lina_prod_ops: Verified acme-markets/org-342 remains on whitelist and still has fncall access. Orbitai confirmed too.

sam_cs: Posting customer note to #customer-notify now, tagging whitelisted orgs and explaining fallback. Template: "We're investigating elevated tool execution traffic and have temporarily limited function execution for non-enterprise plans to protect system stability. If you are impacted and need an exception, reply here with your org id."

maria_oncall: Monitoring. Metrics show fncall rate dropped ~78% and queue depth returning to baseline. Keep this mitigation for 30m, then reassess. If stable, plan to incrementally re-enable with stricter per-tenant caps.

jon_sre: Captured rollback commands in ops runbook and annotated with incident id.

incident-bot: Note: runbook updated. incident_link: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/ALRT-2026-36321

maria_oncall: Handoff: I'll keep the pager for 15m then hand to night tier (jon_night). Lina, Sam — prep customer comms for wider postmortem.

lina_prod_ops: Will compile impacted tenant list and false-positive check.

sam_cs: Will schedule follow-up sync with any customers that reported breakage. Template saved in #cs-templates.

maria_oncall: Closing thread for now — mitigation successful for immediate overload. Keep alerts open. Reopen if fncall rate climbs above 300/min within next 30m. :white_check_mark:
